title: Turn short codewords into erasures until decoding becomes unique
statement: A clean external-column seed plus erasures contains the true retained column space. Repeatedly delete the support of any nonzero codeword of weight<=2delta; each deletion drops code dimension, so at most2r delta additional coordinates are removed before unique radius-delta decoding.
